mcat_description.short: Heavy structural fabrications are large-scale, custom-engineered steel assemblies — including beams, columns, trusses, girders, frames, and platforms — fabricated by cutting, welding, and assembling high-strength steel sections to IS:800 and IS:2062 standards for industrial and infrastructure projects.
mcat_description.long: Heavy structural fabrications encompass the design, cutting, welding, and assembly of massive steel components such as beams, columns, trusses, girders, pipe racks, crane girders, and structural frames used as load-bearing elements in industrial plants, power stations, bridges, and commercial infrastructure. Fabrication is carried out in workshops or on-site using structural steel grades conforming to IS:2062 (E250/E350), with design governed by IS:800:2007 (Limit State Method) covering load combinations, weld joint design, buckling, and corrosion protection. Products are typically custom-engineered to project specifications, with surface treatment (hot-dip galvanising, epoxy paint, or powder coating) applied before delivery and erection. In the Indian B2B market, buyers include EPC contractors, plant owners, and infrastructure developers who procure on a per-kg or per-MT basis against approved fabrication drawings.

market_context: Heavy structural fabrications in India constitute a large and growing B2B segment driven by infrastructure spending under the National Infrastructure Pipeline, Make in India, and accelerated industrial capex in power, oil & gas, and manufacturing sectors. The dominant material is structural steel conforming to IS:2062 (grades E250/E350), with design and fabrication governed by IS:800:2007 (General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice, Third Revision), which mandates the Limit State Method covering load combinations, weld joint design, buckling, fatigue, fire resistance, and seismic provisions per IS:1893. Fabrication processes include precision cutting (plasma, laser, oxy-fuel), rolling, bending, MIG/TIG/submerged arc welding, and surface treatment (hot-dip galvanising, epoxy paint, powder coating). Key product types are beams, columns, trusses, plate girders, crane runway girders, pipe racks, mezzanine platforms, and machine structure frames in both MS (mild steel) and SS (stainless steel). Major Indian players include L&T Heavy Engineering, ISGEC, Braithwaite (GoI/Railways), Zetwerk, Fabmax, Astal Structures, Sahyadri Industries, and TJSV Galvan; EPC contractors (L&T, Thermax) are both buyers and fabricators. Quality certifications commonly required include ISO 9001:2015, third-party weld inspection (NDT), and material test certificates (MTC) per IS:2062. The Pune/Maharashtra region is a notable fabrication hub per keyword geography signals. Transactions are typically custom-engineered against approved drawings, quoted per kg or per MT, with buyers being EPC contractors, plant owners, and government/PSU procurement teams.
